name: Ombre Body Mist- Bali Trip (W) -120ml
description:
"Dance with the tropical rhythm and let the floral beats transport you to a paradise. Smells like whipped Vanilla and Coconut with soothing blend of Heliotrope and Sandalwood. Spray the mist directly on your skin focusing on the nerve points like wrists and neck.
 
Top Note: Whipped Vanilla and Coconut
Middle Note: Heliotrope and Sandalwood
Last Note: Wild Berries, Peach and Mandarin Orange

All-day protection against sweat odor
Long-lasting fragrance
Quick absorption, non-greasy
Inspired by Pink Chiffon from Bath and Body Works
 
Caution:
Do not expose to temperature exceeding 50°C. Avoid direct contact with eyes and broken skin. In case of any irritation, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children."
